newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3935/3.3973 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3935/3.3973 to dlr.

text.p: Private Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3890 to 3.3960 bid and 3.3950 to 3.4000 offered on Thursday in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3935 pounds bid and 3.3973 offered. The averages compared with 3.3939 pounds bid and 3.3966 offered on Wednesday.
The central bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.392150 buy and 3.398894 sell.
